scripts.test: npm run test:tooling && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:services && npm run test:web
scripts.check: npm run test:tooling && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:db && npm run test:services && npm --prefix web run check
scripts.setup: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix contracts ci --ignore-scripts --workspaces=false --allow-git=root && npm --prefix services ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix web ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.test:db: node scripts/require-test-db.mjs && npm --prefix services run test:db
scripts.audit:production: npm --prefix web run audit:production && npm --prefix services audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
